body:
**Source:** the owner's ticketing standard (2026-09-28), story S13 CLAUDE.md fixes the CLI surface by brief 4.12. `trellis ticket new/triage/ready/sweep/scan/index` grows it, so an ADR records the surface, the crate boundary (trellis-tickets depends only on trellis-core) and that GitHub is reached through the `gh` binary rather than an HTTP dependency. **Acceptance:** - An ADR lists the six subcommands and their arguments - The ADR states trellis-tickets depends only on trellis-core - The ADR states no HTTP/GraphQL crate is added **Files:** docs/adr/0027-ticketing-tool.md (new, when decided); docs/ROADMAP.md (link); CLAUDE.md (Commands block) ## Decision Separate binary: `trellis-tickets` (`cargo run -p trellis-tickets -- `), outside the product CLI. Decided 2026-09-28 by the owner, via the coordinator. ## Done when - A new ADR (next free number; 0027 is taken) records the `trellis-tickets` crate and binary, depending only on `trellis-core`, with the rule engine as a library and the six commands as thin wrappers. - It lists the commands and arguments as in the Decision of this issue's history: `new --title --body-file

[--dry-run]`, `triage [--json]`, `ready `, `sweep [--dry-run|--apply]`, `scan []`, `index [--out

]`. - It states GitHub is reached only by spawning `gh` through a helper that applies `trellis_core::secrets::scrub`, and that `scripts/tickets/next.sh` and `sync-ready.py` are replaced only once the tool reproduces their output. ## Verify ``` git grep -q -F -e "trellis-tickets" -- docs/adr/ ``` Pre-check on drain 50b3295: exit 1 ## Tasks - [ ] Draft the ADR with the six subcommands - [ ] State the crate boundary and gh-only access - [ ] Link it from ROADMAP ## Triage ```yaml story: S13 labels: [area:docs, kind:docs, risk:low, surface:internal, effort:s, origin:manual] flags: [] triage: auto triage_reasons: ["no rule routes to a human: area classified, no trust-boundary risk, no owner decision, no open blocker"] ready: true ready_failures: [] triaged_at: 2026-09-28T21:13:17Z triage_version: 2 ```
